2f411c0.summary: Handles a card leaving the game. If it is this card, hides its UI, strips its effects and traits and jams it; otherwise clears the removed card's extrinsic effects. The decompiler has inlined UpdateWhileInPlay and AddEffect, so the pack-bonus and buff-application code is also here, ending with a figures refresh and combination check.
comments: removedCard is the card leaving the game; first branch handles this card itself being removed.
This card was removed: mark it removedFromGame and take its collider out of play.
Stop in-play animations and hide the card's visuals (cardback or 2D face off, 3D body off).
Show the cardback if this state calls for it, otherwise hide the 2D card.
Hide 3D body and extra effects, clear highlight, trait icons and status animations.
Hide the 'created by' label; decompiler tangled the exit paths here, so the tail is unreliable.
Decompiler merged the self-removal cleanup with what follows; the calls below are right.
Removed card is this card: strip all of its active effects and traits (silence it).
Walk the active effects from last to first and remove each one.
Copy the current traits into a temp list so they can be removed without changing the list mid-loop.
Remove every trait on this card.
Clear pending stun and markerlight flags, then add the jam trait (card is now disabled).
Non-hero cards lose their active ability.
Refresh the UI: stop animations, update trait icons and figures, show the jam animation.
Remove any extrinsic effects (auras) that removedCard was giving this card.
Re-run this card's while-in-play update now that the board has changed.
Once-only triggered ability: re-check it and clear the flag if it fired.
Pack trait: attack bonus scales with the number of other friendly troops.
Not a pack card (or still in hand): drop any leftover own pack buff effects.
Pack card still in hand does no scaling, so it takes the cleanup path above.
Count friendly units on the board: a Hero counts them all, other units exclude themselves.
Do nothing if the count is unchanged; otherwise store it and remove the old pack buffs.
Build a fresh extrinsic addStats effect giving +N melee and +N ranged attack, N = troop count.
Inlined AddEffect: refuse (with a warning) if the card is in a state that cannot take effects.
A jammed enchanting card cannot give extrinsic effects.
Extrinsic effect: skip it if the same one is already applied; replace it if the values changed.
Remnants only accept the remnant trait or health buffs.
Source minion must still be in play (or be this card); else warn 'from card no longer in play'.
doubleAttack is converted to an addStats effect adding the current melee attack.
Dispatch on buffType: first the high-numbered ones (set attack, set cost, set health, drop pod, replace ability).
setMeleeAttack / setRangeAttack: remove the previous such effect, add this one, refresh attack text.
Remnant trait is handled by the add-trait case below.
setCost: replace any earlier setCost effect and update the cost text.
setCurrentHealth: fire the Ecstasy trigger if it qualifies, then set current health.
Unknown buffType: log a warning.
Mid-range buffTypes: replaceAbility and addStatsDropPod.
replaceAbility: swap in the new active ability, reset its icon and refresh trait icons.
addStatsDropPod: add the effect and adjust the drop pod health/attack counters.
Switch for low buffTypes: stat buffs, traits, set stats, enchantments, marks of chaos.
Stat buff (addStats and similar): merge into an identical existing effect if possible, else add.
Apply the health change: reductions clamp to max health, heals add to current health.
Armour change is applied through AddArmour.
Search existing effects for same source, buff type and timing; if found, add the new values to it.
addTrait: log it, look up trait data, then handle the special cases.
Poison is cancelled outright if the card has the resistant trait.
Survivor granted with 0 health change is ignored with a warning.
Drop any earlier removeTrait effect for this trait; blind also forces melee and clears expiry flags.
Look for an existing effect of the same trait and stack it per the trait's rule (count, add, replace).
No match found: add this effect; count-stacking traits start at 1.
Flank or fast changes summon sickness visuals.
Drop pod: reset its drop pod health and attack counters to the starting values.
Gaining survivor clears survivorSpent.
Gaining resistant while poisoned shows the animation and cures the poison.
Tide / companion: seed the counters from the current values.
Pindown forces the unit to ranged attack.
Markerlight and hunt mark: broadcast to the other player that the mark resolved.
If the card is on the board, play the trait's activation animation.
Traits changed: refresh the icons (flagged cases jump straight to the combination check).
removeTrait: broadcast stealth loss if needed, record the effect, then remove the trait and its buffed copy.
swapStats: swap attack and health (refused on warlords).
Not a warlord: recompute base attack and max health from intrinsic values plus stat effects.
Warlord: swapping is refused and an error is logged with the player ids.
Reset-stat cases (6 and 0x1e): remove old such effects and all extrinsic effects, then add this one.
Case 8: apply a mark of chaos to this card and tell the other player it resolved.
setHealth: replace earlier setHealth, maybe fire Ecstasy, then set current health and refresh text.
removeExtrinsic: drop all extrinsic effects from the enchanting card.
Enchantment buff types: hand off to AddEnchantment.
Case 0x10: attach an enchantment to this card and give it a unique enchantment id.
Quest enchantment: replace other quest effects, reset the quest counter, show quest status.
Secret-order enchantment is flagged as a secret buff.
Mutation enchantment: spend it, trigger it and run the mutation.
Mark of chaos / wing enchantment: spend, remember as last mark, trigger and broadcast.
Case 0x11: re-trigger the last mark of chaos on this card.
Case 0x19: reflected copy; make the card ephemeral and show that.
Case 0x1e: reset-stat variant, shares the code with case 6.
Case 0x23 (daemonHost) is not implemented: logs an error.
Common exit: refresh stat figures, then check for card combinations.

2f41744.summary: Runs this card's while-in-play and once-only trigger updates, then recomputes the pack troop bonus and applies it as an extrinsic CardEffect. The decompiler has inlined AddEffect, so the whole buff-application switch appears here, ending with a figures refresh and combination check.
